verdict.rationale: Brex ships in-product AI agents and assistants, so asking whether they can consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Brex acting as an MCP server for outside assistants (e.g. 'claude mcp add ... https://api.brex.com/mcp'), which is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows Brex's own AI can connect to or use third-party MCP servers.
